findings.location: Test strategy / Files to change (OrderServiceEndpointFaultTests.cs modification)
findings.problem: The fault-test override uses the Db type and ThrowingHandler, but the design does not note that OrderServiceEndpointFaultTests.cs currently lacks 'using FoodHerons.Api.Data;' (and System.Net.Http), so the new code will not compile until those usings are added.
findings.fix: Add to the Files-to-change bullet: 'add using FoodHerons.Api.Data; (for Db) and using System.Net.Http; to the test file.'

findings.location: Writes via RPC — place_order request body
findings.problem: Each p_items element carries a per-item vendor_id that always equals the order-level p_vendor (verified in OrdersEndpoints.PlaceOrderAsync), but the design never states this single-vendor invariant or that the RPC does not cross-check them.
findings.fix: Add a one-line note: each item's vendor_id always equals p_vendor; the RPC does not cross-check, matching the current unconstrained order_items.vendor_id column (no FK).
